name: Life spaceship 487cf3f7 on 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-13 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003, with touching neighbours, 12 to 44 cells, moving two lattice steps every 13 generations (2c/13). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,9,10/S2,3,9,10. JETCARP's Life census met it in 13 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
